note: Role table for the peer channel. Identity = role, not session name / pid / thread title. Session names are auto-generated or change with /rename; pids get reused; none of them are stable identifiers. What the matcher uses: `cwd_match` (a path fragment, compared per path component, so 'my-repo' does NOT match 'my-repo-2'; put the full path to pin one checkout) and `entrypoints` ('cli' = desktop CLI session, 't3-code' = T3 thread). `repo` is informational only - a T3 thread runs in a worktree outside the repo path, so it cannot be a hard constraint.

desktop.describes: Desktop Claude Code CLI session in your repo. Ask it implementation details it owns.

mobile.describes: T3 Code thread (phone / web / desktop app) working in the same repo. Worktree threads run under <T3_HOME>/worktrees/<name>/<id>.
